name: Content Publishing Job
description: Cron-driven jobs that unpublish nodes of a content type once a configured date field has passed.
project_description:
The Content Publishing Job module allows you to display other a block of contents of your choice on any content type you want. The contents displayed are related to the current content based on the taxonomy term field you gave.

The second functionality is the possibility to create job that unpublish automatically a content if its publication date is expired.

 Features 
 - Displays related contents on the content details page.

- Unpublish automatically some contents when they are expired.

 Post-Installation 
 1. After enabling the module, configure block settings and permissions.

2. Place the Related contents block in a region using the block layout manager.

3. Then go to the configuration page (`/admin/config/system/publishing-config`)

4. Finally, create jobs to be executed for the content type of your choice.
